purpose: A full-page error in plain words — page not found, a server error or offline — with the way back.

props.name: variant
props.description: Which error; sets the default code, icon and copy

props.name: primaryAction
props.description: The way back, such as a link to the home page

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: Another way forward, such as Contact support

whenToUse: A page that cannot be shown: missing, failed or offline
whenNotToUse: An error in one part of a page — use Banner
A form error — use the field's error message
antiPatterns: An error page with no way back
a11yNotes: One main landmark with an h1

slots.name: primaryAction
slots.description: The way back. Example: Go to the home page.
